requirements.quote:
Therefore, all Application-
   Layer Protocol Negotiation (ALPN) [RFC7301] codepoints specified to
   operate over QUIC version 1 can also operate over this version of
   QUIC.
requirements.condition: when an ALPN codepoint is specified to operate over QUIC version 1
requirements.required_behavior: allow that ALPN codepoint to operate over QUIC version 2
requirements.forbidden_behavior: reject the ALPN codepoint solely because the connection uses QUIC version 2
requirements.why_checkable: Each ALPN codepoint supported over QUIC version 1 can be negotiated over QUIC version 2 to verify the same application capability is available.

requirements.quote:
In particular, both the "h3" [HTTP/3] and "doq" [RFC9250]
   ALPNs can operate over QUIC version 2.
requirements.condition: when negotiating the "h3" ALPN over QUIC version 2
requirements.required_behavior: allow the "h3" ALPN to operate over QUIC version 2
requirements.forbidden_behavior: reject the "h3" ALPN solely because the connection uses QUIC version 2
requirements.why_checkable: A QUIC version 2 connection can negotiate "h3" and be checked for successful HTTP/3 operation.

requirements.quote:
In particular, both the "h3" [HTTP/3] and "doq" [RFC9250]
   ALPNs can operate over QUIC version 2.
requirements.condition: when negotiating the "doq" ALPN over QUIC version 2
requirements.required_behavior: allow the "doq" ALPN to operate over QUIC version 2
requirements.forbidden_behavior: reject the "doq" ALPN solely because the connection uses QUIC version 2
requirements.why_checkable: A QUIC version 2 connection can negotiate "doq" and be checked for successful DNS-over-QUIC operation.

requirements.quote:
Unless otherwise stated, all QUIC extensions defined to work with
   version 1 also work with version 2.
requirements.condition: when a QUIC extension is defined to work with version 1 and no exception is stated
requirements.required_behavior: support the extension with QUIC version 2
requirements.forbidden_behavior: treat the extension as incompatible solely because the connection uses QUIC version 2
requirements.why_checkable: An extension supported with QUIC version 1 can be exercised with version 2 to verify equivalent applicability unless its specification states an exception.
